experiment: One fresh three-source full-native-PNG test of unchanged V6C
baseline: Actual extracted V5 stage2_motion_collision, four original NF4 calls per file
input: All existing native zero-based PNG frames, unchanged case/mapping/source hashes; no new sampling or JPEG conversion
source_freeze: May be prepared before human contact reviews; no review files or new labels are read by freeze
mandatory_run_precondition: Separate immutable review_binding.json must be produced by a real review importer validating three actual user observed-contact drafts against frozen source and native mapping. Missing binding always blocks before model load. No invented reviews or auto-GT promotion.
review_inference_separation: Run hashes original review bytes but does not parse human descriptions, answers or contact numbers. It reads only importer validation status, source/mapping hashes and observed-contact availability.
scoring: One unchanged C dual motion scan computes original V5 base and uncapped-jerk scores. Independently recompute original score expression from recorded float32 features. Original base scores feed all four V5 calls, then only collision_frame uses C apply_collision.
console: ID/status only; prompts/raw answers retained in trace files without printing predictions
search_limit: One fixed C candidate; no thresholds, caps, weights, sampling or per-ID retuning after new results
adoption: Passing this small contact-reference test is necessary but does not itself authorize packaging/submission; source overlap, extraction/offline equivalence and resource requirements remain separate. Stage1/3 unchanged.
limitations: New exact source SHA and pending source groups are not proof of incident/device independence. Single-human references are not official/adjudicated GT. Full S2 remains null. PNG density contract is not verified byte-identical hidden JPEG preprocessing.
